purpose: Eliminate caller-controlled registry source substitution from the public promotion evaluator.
requirements: Remove customRegistryPath and every caller-selected registry source from the public evaluator and exported API. Public evaluation must only load the canonical anchored registry.
Enforce the registry anchor independently: exact canonical path plus hard-coded digest or public-key signature verification. Sidecar alone is not an authenticity anchor.
Keep any alternate registry support internal to test-only code, unexported and structurally incapable of returning VERIFIED through the public evaluator.

Add attacks using a schema-valid forged registry whose leaf, raw SHA, metadata SHA, selector, range and card ID all match a forged fixture; caller path override, path alias and symlink/junction variants must all fail closed at public API.
Make verify-existing validate canonical registry anchor before computing outputs. Record anchor method and digest/signature verification result in receipt.

Preserve broad-shell rejection, sealed metadata bindings and semantic checks. Evaluate only existing sealed R3 bytes; retain 0 VERIFIED / 10 HELD and do not hydrate/package/deploy/mutate scheduler, alias or rollback.
acceptance_gate: CEO verify-existing replay and public-API substitution review required; no automatic promotion
